'''Grav-press bandage cuffs''' were used to stop bleeding in limbs. Some of them were made by [[Sluissi]]. They used micro-[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] fields to stop arterial bleeding.<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>
